The decisive mistake was WebSurfer's at step 16. The orchestrator had just asked WebSurfer to read the opened PDF for the fish bag volume. Instead, WebSurfer typed "volume of fish bag" into the unrelated "Return to Article Details" element and landed back on the article abstract page. It never scrolled or searched the PDF it was viewing.

This wasted the chance to find the answer in the paper itself. The later attempts at steps 24 and 47 also only showed page 1 of 7. The run then fell back on FileSurfer, which hit 404 errors on a file that did not exist, and ended with an unsupported answer of 12.6.

AGENT: WebSurfer
STEP: 16
